title: Antifragille: Things That Gain from Disorder | Nassim Nicholas Taleb | Talks at Google
summary: Nassim Nicholas Taleb talks at Google about his book Antifragile, on systems that gain from disorder and volatility. It draws on themes from his earlier books.
why: HN mentions it mostly in passing as a Taleb talk on market volatility and predicting crises.

quote.text: I think Nassim Taleb should have deserved it, for actually "predicting" the crises.
